name: Ishaq Dar
role: Senator, Deputy Prime Minister and former Finance Minister
notes: Enacted the Income Support Levy Act, 2013 (0.5% wealth tax on net movable assets over Rs 1 million) as Finance Minister.

name: Asad Umar
notes: Announced plans as incoming Finance Minister in 2018 to introduce a wealth tax to cover revenue lost from reducing production taxes; reaffirmed at SDPI in April 2019.

name: Dr. Kaiser Bengali
role: Economist and former advisor to Sindh and Balochistan governments
notes: Advocated reintroduction of compulsory wealth tax targeting 700,000 affluent households identified by NADRA and FBR in post-budget analysis (June 2013).

name: Dr. Umair Javed
role: Assistant Professor of Politics and Sociology, LUMS
notes: Co-author of ICTD Policy Brief 17 (2025) and Dawn analysis 'Pakistan's support for wealth taxes' (June 2025).

name: Dr. Max Gallien
role: Research Fellow, Institute of Development Studies / ICTD
affiliation: International Centre for Tax and Development
notes: Co-lead researcher on ICTD Policy Brief 17 and Dawn op-ed (June 2025) analyzing public support for wealth taxation in Pakistan.

name: Dr. Vanessa van den Boogaard
role: Research Fellow, Institute of Development Studies / ICTD
affiliation: International Centre for Tax and Development
notes: Co-author of ICTD Policy Brief 17 and Dawn op-ed (June 2025) on progressive wealth taxation in Pakistan.

name: International Centre for Tax and Development
notes: Published Policy Brief 17 (2025) presenting survey findings and policy design roadmap for progressive wealth taxation in Pakistan.

name: Farooq Tariq
role: President, Haqooq-e-Khalq Party; General Secretary, Pakistan Kissan Rabita Committee
notes: Advocates progressive wealth taxation on the super-rich, large landholders, and corporations.

name: Dr. S. Akbar Zaidi
role: Executive Director, Institute of Business Administration (IBA) Karachi
notes: Advocated wealth tax and direct taxation of accumulated wealth over taxing salaried employees at Karachi Press Club forum (June 2019).

name: Huzaima Bukhari
